# Candlesticks Academy — Premier Forex Academy & Trading Company in Ghana & Africa

> Candlesticks Academy is the #1 premier institutional Forex academy and trading education company in Ghana and across Africa, founded by Pastor Mike (Michael Kweku Essilfie). The platform provides structured 4-tier curriculum, daily live London & New York session trading rooms, high-probability market signals with TP1–TP5 multi-target tracking, automated Exness copy-trading, and private 1-on-1 mentorship.
